title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Declined Fees and Past-Due Memberships
content:
# Declined fees and past-due memberships (Wayfare Pass)

## Terms

1. When a renewal fee of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership is declined, the membership becomes past due and the fee is retried the plan's number of retries, the plan's retry interval in calendar days apart; each declined attempt is recorded as one declined attempt on the membership ledger, the scheduled attempt and each retry alike.
2. While past due the membership gives no benefits: no member discount, no ride credit earning and no fee waivers, although credit already earned can still be spent. On every plan, benefits do not apply while the membership is past due.
3. If the fee is collected (a retry, or a payment method the member adds) before the plan's grace period in calendar days has passed since the first decline, the membership becomes active again with the same period dates; otherwise it ends on the day the grace period runs out.
4. A declined initial or trial conversion fee is not retried: the membership ends at once.

## Status movements under these terms

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| active | a renewal fee is declined | past due |
| past due | a retry or a new payment method collects the renewal fee | active, same period dates |
| past due | the grace period ends without payment | cancelled |
| enrolled | the first membership fee is declined | cancelled, without benefits |
| trial | the trial conversion fee is declined | cancelled |

## Questions answered

- *Can a past-due member still use Pass ride credit?* Yes. Credit already earned can still be spent; only new benefits stop.
- *Does a trip taken while past due earn ride credit or a member discount?* No. While past due the membership gives no discount, no credit earning and no fee waivers.
- *Is a declined trial conversion fee retried?* No. The membership ends at once.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Wayfare Pass Monthly renewal (3 retries, 2 calendar days apart, 7 days of grace) is declined on its renewal date. The membership is past due from that day. If the second retry collects the fee, the membership is active again with the period dates it already had. If no attempt and no new payment method collects the fee, the membership ends on the day the 7-day grace period runs out.
